574-856-5776-8347.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Sela trigger.
Resolve the Sela trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-856-5776-8347.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

1445-2292-4871-8347.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-2292-4871-8347.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Sela triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

1770-2226-8306.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1770-2226-8306.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Elesh Norn.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Keymaster Rogue by paying its mana cost.
When Keymaster Rogue enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

147-413-653.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-413-653.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Dualcaster Mage targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more lore counters on it

1479-2841-3318-7885.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-7885.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Down in the Valley and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Down in the Valley trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Down in the Valley from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Down in the Valley triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-5571-6922--6.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
3899-5571-6922--6.description:
Use Coveted Falcon to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.

728-2730-6553.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-4247-7918.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Sifa Grent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-7918.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Sifa Grent triggers, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Sifa Grent trigger.
Resolve the Sifa Grent trigger, causing an opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3473-7841.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 20 or higher.
3473-7841.description:
Cast Transcendence by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}.
Transcendence triggers due to you having 20 or more life. However, you cannot lose the game due to Darksteel Angel.
Step 2 repeats in an infinite loop, causing the game to end in a draw if it isn't interacted with.
3473-7841.notes: Note that if Darksteel Angel is removed from the battlefield, you will lose the game due to Transcendence's effect.

1895-4399-4770-6720.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Case of the Uneaten Feast trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4770-6720.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

104-549-4186-6830.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-549-4186-6830.description:
Gain life in any way.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2557-5220-6351-6961.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
2034-2557-5220-6351-6961.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Teval triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

2793-3698-5089-6459.description:
If Karn has exactly one loyalty counter on it, activate its first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Activate Grinding Station by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus. Ugin's Nexus will be exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Aetheric Amplifier by paying {4} and tapping it, doubling the number of counters on Karn.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Nexus by paying {5}.
Repeat from step 2.

777-3532-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
777-3532-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

2060-3054-3967-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-3054-3967-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-3054-3967-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

4053-5295-5499--6.notablePrerequisites: The creature with undying does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
4053-5295-5499--6.description:
Activate the creature with undying by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {3}.
When the creature dies, Solemnity triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {3}, attaching it to the undying creature.
Repeat.

2556-3542-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2556-3542-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron, targeting Mnemonic Wall
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall.
When the Mnemonic Wall token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Mnemonic Wall and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2921-5263-6243.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

878-1651-2751-4231.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature with power 1 or greater.
878-1651-2751-4231.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Ziatora triggers, causing you to sacrifice another creature with power one or greater.
Ziatora triggers, holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Resolve the copy of Ziatora's ability, dealing damage equal to the sacrificed creature's power to any target and creating three Treasure, three Food and three Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Food and/or Clue tokens, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Ziatora's ability.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1233-1849-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1233-1849-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Squee as attackers.
Squee triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1641-2034-4055-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {C}{C}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {G}.
Repeat.

524-3777.description:
Aether Storm prevents creature spells from being cast.
Because Phyrexian Revoker prevents Aether Storm's activated ability from being activated, it cannot be destroyed due to its ability.

976-1841-2498-3260.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 3.
{B} or an additional 2 life available.
976-1841-2498-3260.description:
Activate Greed by paying {B/P} and 2 life, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat.

539-1636-3136-3346-5220.notablePrerequisites: Bog Glider does not have summoning sickness.
539-1636-3136-3346-5220.description:
Activate Bog Glider by tapping it and sacrificing Changeling Outcast.
When Changeling Outcast dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bog Glider ability, searching your library for Changeling Outcast and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Changeling Outcast enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1526-4326-4499-4918.notablePrerequisites:
Circle of Dreams Druid does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two other creatures.
An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1526-4326-4499-4918.description:
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Circle of Dreams Druid by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Multiform Wonder.
Multiform Wonder enters the battlefield, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Resolve the Lightning Runner ability from step 1, causing you to get {E}{E}, then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control, and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1256-1283-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Saprolings.
1256-1283-2440.description:
Activate Jade Mage by paying {3}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
The Saproling token enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes, adding {C} for each Saproling on the battlefield.
Repeat.

1912-2143.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {2}, creating two 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate both Eldrazi Spawn tokens by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

339-677-1636-5256.notablePrerequisites:
Jegantha does not have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken Elemental creature.
339-677-1636-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing any other nontoken Elemental creature, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that can't be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, casting any Elemental creature from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
The Elemental enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

751-1741-2397.notablePrerequisites: Two lands that can produce at least {1}{U}.
751-1741-2397.description:
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve the first Cloud of Faeries ability, untap two lands.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping those, adding at least {1}{U}.
Repeat step 3 for each remaining Cloud of Faeries trigger  Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve the first Shrieking Drake ability, returning itself to hand.
Resolve the second Shrieking Drake ability, returning Cloud of Faeries to hand.
Repeat.
